description.value: Cedar Cafe is a cafe nestled inside the Museum of Anthropology on the UBC campus, on the traditional, ancestral, and unceded territory of the Musqueam people. It offers espresso drinks made from locally roasted beans, sandwiches, bannock, and artisanal pastries in a setting surrounded by one of Canada's premier Indigenous art collections. For cyclists riding the UBC loop or exploring Point Grey, it is a culturally distinctive spot to refuel mid-ride.
